vehicles.name: Striker
vehicles.description: Balanced all-rounder. No weaknesses, no stand-out strengths.

vehicles.name: Bulwark
vehicles.description: Armoured brawler. Shrugs off hits and wins shoving matches, slow to turn and accelerate.

vehicles.name: Wasp
vehicles.description: Featherweight speed machine. Highest top speed, fragile and easily shoved.

vehicles.name: Dart
vehicles.description: Explosive launch and quick recovery after crashes or respawns; runs out of puff at the top end.

vehicles.name: Talon
vehicles.description: High-grip precision car. Carries speed through corners, punishing to drive sloppily.

vehicles.name: Ravager
vehicles.description: Combat chassis with extra armour and fast turbo build from drifting. Average pace.

vehicles.name: Tether
vehicles.description: Hooks the car ahead with a grapple winch and reels into its slipstream. Otherwise plain.

vehicles.name: Mender
vehicles.description: A sturdy tourer carrying a repair drone: patches itself up quickly between fights. Slow to get going.

vehicles.name: Sweeper
vehicles.description: Plough-nosed and sealed: shrugs off oil and ice, and mines do 30% less damage.

vehicles.name: Skylark
vehicles.description: Light stunt car with hover jets: steers in the air and always lands clean. Fragile.
